notes.title: Potion Commotion's Newest Content Update is Now Live
notes.notes:
[h2]Bugs (the Insect kind)[/h2]
This latest update brings some new critters into your garden. From Level 5 onwards, Snails, Bees, and Ladybugs will all make appearances in your garden and can be collected for Coins and Elixir.

Also, there are Dragonflies, who will only show up in the City! So be sure to keep an eye out for them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36859823/f7249f3997dee5623bfb828415fe893fefe671e8.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing Huesna[/h2]
Huesna's House is a new addition to the Eldershire City Street and can be found next to Olga's Tent.
There you can interact with the lovely Huesna (and her Kitty, Coco), who will give you tokens in exchange for rescuing Insects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36859823/5ff1315ce286d69ca520bb61f250cd93fd7e8643.png[/img]

[h2]Stamp Collecting[/h2]
On the other side of the City, beside the Wishing Well, is where Jimmy the Stamp Fanatic has set up his Stamp Shop. This is where you can check out your newly-attained Stampbook, it'll be empty, to begin with, but you can purchase Stamp Packs from Jimmy to start building your collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36859823/830fc58e3fe745d63ac12f8a40e6c1bab4943317.png[/img]

Using Tokens, you can purchase Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Rainbow Stamp Packs, to unlock new Stamps at random. In total there are 120! Can you complete your Stampbook? There are fun rewards along the way.

[b]Bug Fixes and Game Improvements[/b]
-Fixed a Bug where Golden Eggs were not being automatically collected quick enough and fell into the City Street.
-Corrected a Land Expansion TextBox message that had a grammatical error.
-Corrected an Upgrade Button TextBox message for the Phonebox.

Thank you for your continued support, I appreciate it greatly.
Be sure to let me know if you encounter any issues. I always welcome feedback and suggestions too.

Join the new [url=https://discord.com/invite/dsyn3VDhxc]Discord[/url].

Stay awesome you guys!
Kind regards,
Luke of NerdyBird Studios.

notes.title: Potion Commotion Version 1.2.4
notes.notes:
Hey all, I hope you are well.
I have plenty of news to announce regarding the recent DLC giveaway promotion, the imminent launch of my Patreon, future content updates, and more!
However, I'm going to wait until my next post to elaborate further on those topics.

For now, I'd just like to tell you that Potion Commotion has had a new update. It is small, and mostly just contains a few bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

Here is a list of changes in Version 1.2.4:

[b]Game Improvements[/b]
-Added 35 new Loading Messages (Mostly jokes)
-Upgraded to a newer version of Unity (2020.3.26f1)
-Increased Inventory Capacity when Prestiging so that you will always be able to make an Upgraded Potion regardless of its Ingredient Requirements.
-Revamped the 'Socials' Page and Added the Official NerdyBird Studios Instagram to it.
-Altered Discord Link(s) to the new Discord Server
-Reduced 'For the Longest Time' Achievement requirements to 24 hours for Silver, and 72 hours for Gold.
-Added Colour to Text Buttons as Indicators on the Daily Reward UI
-Very slightly enlarged the Size of Wogglebogg's House and made some minor furniture readjustments

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
-Fixed an audio clip from the Barrell of Laughs that accidentally played for 19 Seconds
-Corrected 3 Olga Subtitles which were shown at the wrong time
-Fixed an issue where the Ultimate Potion Tab Info Text would not Update
-Fixed a bug where the City and Wardrobe Buttons would be interactable while a Menu was still in use
-Fixed an Incorrect Textbox Message when Trying to Expand Land while Level is too low
-If you increase your Prestige Level from a Monthly Reward, your Inventory capacity will now increase at the same time, without the need to reboot your game.

Thank you for your continued support, I appreciate it greatly.
Be sure to let me know if you encounter any issues. I always welcome feedback and suggestions too.

Join the new [url=https://discord.com/invite/dsyn3VDhxc]Discord[/url].

Stay awesome you guys!
Kind regards,
Luke of NerdyBird Studios.

notes.title: Potion Commotion V 1.2.3 Release
notes.notes:
Hi all,
After further playtesting by myself, as well as monitoring your feedback, I am happy to introduce PoCo Version 1.2.3, a small update that introduces some more small bug fixes and improvements.
Cheers to everybody for your continued support, I appreciate it greatly!

Here’s what has changed in V 1.2.3:

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Upgraded to a newer version of Unity (2020.3.2f1)
- Corrected a TextBox Message incorrectly saying you've collected all the 'Coins' rather than 'Elixir' when interacting with the Elixir Jug.
- Gnome Positioning, while the player is not in the garden, has been improved.
- Horoscopes no longer only change Monthly, they change upon each session of the game.
- Certain Clothing Unlock Requirements have been altered.
- Monthly Loyalty Rewards have been altered to gift Automatic Level Ups for the foreseeable.
- 'Somebody Once Told Me' achievement updated to require Star Trees in the first three Tree Spaces.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Special Helpers will now return to the City as intended when their stay in the garden has ended.
- Fallback code that will ensure Special Helpers always remain in the City or Garden.

Thanks for checking out this post everyone, and don’t forget that you’re always welcome to get in touch, I love interacting with you all.
Our Discord: https://discord.gg/ByNsGUC

Happy Potion Making!
- Luke of NerdyBird Studios

notes.title: Potion Commotion Fanbook Release
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1438020/Potion_Commotion_Fanbook/

Today marks the day that the first of many planned DLC releases for Potion Commotion, has been launched.

The Potion Commotion Digital Fanbook is a fun, little project that I've been working on recently, showcasing a bunch of PoCo related content, such as character profiles, game art, information about the game's development, commentary, trivia, and even a bonus Puzzle page that the player could print out and solve.

It has been written and designed by myself, the developer, with some assistance (and grammar checking) from my awesome family! It comes in a PDF format, which can be opened with most browsers.

I hope this will be a cool surprise for fans of the game, as this will feature new lore, detailed character backgrounds, as well as explain Potion Commotion's journey and what ideas were initially intended.
Also, it's a nice little way to help me out financially, for future projects and updates, which is always immensely appreciated, as I'm a Solo Dev.

Speaking of updates, I am planning several [b]big[/b] expansions to the Potion Commotion universe, new characters, potions, locations, and even costumes are all on the way!! And don't forget the brand new puns and jokes!!
So stay tuned because it won't be too long before more announcements are on the way.
I expect the first of which to be out before the end of 2020.

To celebrate this release, PoCo, its Soundtrack, and the newly-available Fanbook are all currently 50% off for 14 days. Don't miss out!

Thank you so much for reading this, and I hope you all are doing alright and keeping well during this pandemic. Stay strong, and in the words of Wogglebogg, "Happy Potion Making everybody!!"
- Luke of NerdyBird Studios

[i]To access a purchased Fanbook, go to Library > Potion Commotion > Manage > Browse Local Files > Potion Commotion Fanbook.pdf[/i]

Discord: https://discord.gg/ByNsGUC

notes.title: Potion Commotion V 1.0.2 Release
notes.notes:
Hello once again folks, I hope you’re all doing well.
I’ve been keeping track of your feedback for Potion Commotion and after working on some updates, Version 1.0.2 is now ready to go.
Thank you all for your continued support, I appreciate each and every one of you.

Here’s what has changed in V 1.0.2:

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Upgraded to the latest version of Unity (2019.3.13f1)
- Altered the ‘Prestige’ Shop and Info Screen Icon
- Added a TextBox message and an audio alert when you try to purchase a Prestige with insufficient funds.
- Adjusted Prestige and Restart confirmation Text and Button position.
- Removed the ‘Prestige’ Upgrade Button function as it was potentially confusing to some.
- Lowered the requirement of ‘Upgrader – Gold’ from 105 Upgrades, to 100.
- Making a Potion that is different from the previous, now provides a 20% Coin Boost from Level 15 rather than 10%.
- Special Helper hiring costs have been reduced slightly.
- Female Goblins now appear from Level 5 rather than Level 4.
- The ‘Somebody Once Told Me’ achievement can now also be triggered by having All Star Trees in the first four Trees Spaces on the Left, or the first four Tree Spaces on the Right.
- The ‘Upgrades Made’ stat no longer resets upon a Prestige or Restart
- Corrected a spelling mistake of the word ‘Chillies’
- Altered a Beta Tester Credit.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a Bug that may have been causing collected daily bonuses to not count towards the ‘Seven Days a Week’ achievement if the game had been running overnight.
- The Female Goblins no longer steal 0 Elixir on occasions.
- Removed an error where the Credits started from the wrong position after reopening them from the room you didn’t initially enable them.
- Prestige cost is now fixed at 1,000,000 Coins whereas it wasn't being set properly before.

[b]News[/b]
- I am also happy to tell you that I’ve created all the Trading Card Assets for Potion Commotion, and will be releasing them as soon as Steam decide this game is eligible for Trading Cards.
(This, unfortunately, is out of our control so we can’t say when we will be allowed)
- I am potentially looking at releasing Potion Commotion onto Linux in the future, so I'm on the hunt for Linux Testers. Please contact me (preferably through Discord) if you are interested or know someone who might be.

Thanks for checking out this post everyone, and don’t forget that you’re always welcome to get in touch, I love interacting with you all.
Our Discord: https://discord.gg/ByNsGUC

Happy Potion Making!
- Luke of NerdyBird Studios

notes.title: Potion Commotion V 1.0.1 Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you so much for your fantastic support for Potion Commotion thus far. It means the world to us that you're taking the time to check out our game!!!

Following some player feedback, along with continued developer testing, we have made some improvements and fixed some bugs to make Potion Commotion a better game for all.
We appreciate anyone who has provided constructive analysis and have taken on board your comments. Here are the contents of the new update:

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Upgraded to the latest version of Unity (2019.3.10f1)
- Increased Offline Progression rewards from Level 11 onwards. With each level thereafter up until 30, providing a bigger boost.
- Lowered the requirements for each of the 'You've been GNOMED!' achievements
- Added a Beta Tester Credit and altered another upon Request

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed the 'For the longest time - Silver' achievement, it now triggers at 30 hours as intended, rather than 40.
- Correction of incorrect Subtitles from Wogglebogg and Hamrietta (we are still checking these further)
- Added Steam Stat updates for various in-game stats
- Wishing Well Button no longer appears upon the load of the 'Game' Scene

Thanks again for reading and don't hesitate to get in touch with us if you have any queries or concerns!
Our Discord: https://discord.gg/ByNsGUC

Happy Potion Making!
- Luke of NerdyBird Studios
